question: What totality is being indicated such that the field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs is named as a single object?
premises: The total field-group of these yoginīs is named.
inference: The verse presents a single total field-group comprising all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
uncertainties: The function of that field-group is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: The all-field-group of all earth-moving and all sky-moving yoginīs.
